div.div: Grafana is the window for fleet health, queue depths, alerts and the smoke results. The per-job drill-down is Explore by job_id in Loki: a line's trace_id opens its trace in Tempo, and its job_id opens the job's workflow page in the Temporal UI, as a span's temporalWorkflowID does. With the UI off, temporal workflow show through a forward of the frontend gives the same timeline. Temporal keeps a closed workflow's history 24 hours.
